PPO with the same regret sampling. Full 8M, never left D0. Held-out D0 48.0mg/34.7 p25/7.5% crash (3/4); adversarial cold starts crash 75%. Regret sampling never destabilized PPO.

Blend 0.08. User-stopped at 17k steps due to unrelated CPU load. Inconclusive.

Blend 0.08 on an idle machine. Good first 2 chunks, then 100.5->42.9mg. Root cause: regret compared every bucket to one absolute mg target despite 4-15x population differences. Fix: crash-rate-only regret.
Confound fixed, still declined 79.9->28.2mg over chunks 4-11. After three attempts, regret sampling disabled for TD3 (its replay buffer can't tolerate a shifting training distribution); kept for PPO.

Regret off. Stable 10 chunks, then collapsed to one saturated corner action on every input. Root cause: LSTM cell state grows unbounded over the rollout and freezes the actor; explains v33/v34/v40/v42/v43/v44. see decision_history #--legacy-TD3-py-107-lstm-cell-state-saturation
Fix: reset LSTM hidden state every 60 steps. Full 2M with zero collapse, D0->D2. 40-seed held-out 95.7mg/62.1 p25/0% crash: first RL run in the project to pass the full D2 gate.
Crash penalty -100->-10, graduated decline warning, reproducible reset seeds. Stopped at ~62% of chunk 1 and superseded by v47 (was optimizing against the old blind gate).
